name: OLED display 128x64 (SSD1306, I2C)
description: 0.96 in monochrome OLED, 128 x 64 pixels, on the SSD1306 controller over I2C (address 0x3C, or 0x3D with the address jumper). Wire GND → GND, VCC → 5V (or 3.3V), SCL → A5, SDA → A4 on an Uno. Works with Adafruit_SSD1306 (display.begin(SSD1306_SWITCHCAPVCC, 0x3C)) and U8g2 (U8G2_SSD1306_128X64_NONAME_F_HW_I2C).

pins.label: VCC
pins.description: 3.3 to 5 V supply; the module has its own 3.3 V regulator and charge pump.

pins.label: SCL
pins.description: I2C clock. Uno: A5. 4.7 kOhm pull-up to VCC on the module.

pins.label: SDA
pins.description: I2C data. Uno: A4. 4.7 kOhm pull-up to VCC on the module.

props.label: I2C address
props.description: 0x3C on most modules; 0x3D when the address jumper on the back is moved.

props.label: Pixel colour
props.description: Panel colour. yellow-blue is the two-colour panel: the top 16 rows are yellow, the rest blue.

footprint: 27 x 27 mm module, 4-pin 0.1 in header (GND VCC SCL SDA)

bindings.description: Panel is lit: powered, display ON (0xAF) and the charge pump enabled.

The displayed image (after remap, offset, invert): base64 of 1 bit per pixel, row-major, MSB = leftmost pixel, 16 bytes per row, 64 rows. Decode with decodeMonoFrame(pixels, 128, 64) from @faber/sim-core.
Counts changes of the displayed image; a renderer redraws only when it changes.
Approximate pixel brightness 0.35..1 from the contrast.
Panel colour prop: white, blue or yellow-blue.
Number of lit pixels on screen (handy in tests).
True when no pixel is lit (dark panel or empty screen). Handy in scenario tests: expect oled.blank == false.
1 when the panel is lit, 0 when dark (bound in the SVG).

mechanical.source: typical 0.96 in module (active area 21.74 x 10.86 mm)
